title: Add subtract(a, b) function to app.py
description: Implement a subtract(a, b) function in backend/app.py, following the same style and conventions as the existing add(a, b) function, and write a corresponding unit test that verifies correct subtraction behavior including edge cases (e.g. negative numbers, zero).
acceptance_criteria: backend/app.py contains a subtract(a, b) function that returns a - b
The function signature and style match the existing add(a, b) function
A unit test exists that calls subtract(a, b) with at least one typical case and one edge case (e.g. negative numbers or zero) and asserts the expected result
All existing tests, including the new subtract test, pass
